<div class="card-body">
'''Exhaustion''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊体力の消耗</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：相手は、場に出ている相手のキャラクターのうち、行方不明になっている者が１名いるごとに、１フォース失う。２：“夜間状態”で行方不明となっているキャラクターを１名選び、ロストさせる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Exhaustion-PSA-154944005.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「船長。気温は急激に低下しています」
「わかってる。だが仲間を見殺しには出来ねえ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Exhaustion of stamina.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: The opponent loses 1 Force for each of the opponent's missing characters on table.

2: Choose one character missing under 'nighttime conditions' to be lost.

'''Lore:'''
"Captain. The temperature is falling rapidly." "I know. But I can't leave a friend to die."
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Exhaustion]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
